⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新郎|しんろう}→新郎：12982_shinrou⟧⟦{新婦|しんぷ}→新婦：12981_shinpu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ファーストダンス→ファーストダンス：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踊|おど}った→踊る：01250_odoru⟧。
examples.english: The bride and groom danced their first dance at the wedding.

notes:
ダンス refers primarily to Western-style dancing. It is used as both a noun (ダンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧) and a suru verb (ダンス⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

CONTRAST WITH JAPANESE DANCE:
- ダンス: Western-style dance (ballroom, hip-hop, ballet, etc.)
- ⟦{踊|おど}り→踊り：01347_odori⟧: dance in general, or traditional Japanese dance
- ⟦{舞|まい}→舞：noentry⟧: classical/ceremonial Japanese dance (more formal than ⟦{踊|おど}り→踊り：01347_odori⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ダンス⟦をする→する：00392_suru⟧ / ダンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧: to dance
- ダンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: to learn dance
- ⟦ダンス{教室|きょうしつ}→ダンス教室：noentry⟧: dance class/studio
- ⟦{社交|しゃこう}→社交：13742_shakou⟧ダンス: ballroom dancing
- ⟦ダンスパーティー→ダンスパーティー：noentry⟧: dance party

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dance has become increasingly popular in Japan. Since 2012, dance has been a required part of the middle school physical education curriculum.
